changelog: Orbital Strike and Air Strike are aimable again. They went tile-targeted last build, but the game was only highlighting the empty ring beside your OWN base — so you could never actually drop one on the enemy. Fixed. BARRAGE REWORKED: it now walks a 3x3 of shells over the ground you pick, each shell cratering its own tile for 5 and half that one step out; the blasts overlap, so the aim point takes the worst of it. Upgraded, it's a 5x5 at 7 per shell. Costs 3. PIERCE IS FOR DIRECT HITS ONLY — a shell that lands squarely on a unit ignores armor and cover, but blast damage never does, so tanks shrug off splash they're merely near. That correction also reaches rocket blasts, the Bombardier's shell, Incite Mutiny and Grid Overload. NOTHING IS SAFE FROM SPLASH ANY MORE — your own HQ included. Level your own base and the game has something to say about it. The ENEMY now fires the same Air Strike and Barrage you do (it used to poke a single target with them), though it won't shell its own line. Nomad buffed: a second Attack Dog in the starting roster, and Momentum banks up to 5 a turn so Break Camp comes around faster.
